purpose: Check structural-journal interaction with the unchanged _SourceTransport using only synthetic inner-client objects.
new_evidence: The completed offline adapter uses a parser stub; old 28 response replays used frozen runners without the new persistence wrapper. Their combined return-boundary behavior has not been checked.

implementation_scope.shape: Test-only compatibility harness, no production entry point, no existing source changes. Reuse pinned helper and offline exclusive-write primitives without modifying either. Each synthetic branch has an independently named permanent owner/reservation in a disposable private test scope. The fixed scope registry is independent of out_name.
implementation_scope.live_transport: Install counted socket/socket.create_connection and urllib guards first. Under those guards import healthbench after static top-level inspection, then deny actual Transport class __init__/request/complete/model_metadata with patch.object. Only then import _SourceTransport and transitive dependencies. Existing aliases reference the same blocked class. Keep all guards through test and cleanup. No real Transport is constructed; only the unchanged _SourceTransport and registered fake inner are instantiated. Do not patch _SourceTransport code, read credentials, accept endpoints, call metadata/template or invoke production runner entrypoints.
implementation_scope.pins: Before fake dispatch verify fixed helper, wrapper, persistence and harness/fixture source hashes; verify after each case. Snapshot imported local dependency files in the future implementation manifest and preserve them. All model/template checks absent, not simulated as live identity evidence.

boundary.location: _SourceTransport(fixture_observer).complete(payload); fixture_observer obtains a registered fake object, persists response_metadata, then returns that exact object.
boundary.legacy_behavior: _SourceTransport increments calls before inner client, initializes provider_response_received=False, and sets True only after normal inner return. An inner storage error maps to transport_failure and leaves that legacy flag False.
boundary.separate_evidence: A durable journal may independently prove parsed_object_observed=True before a storage error. Do not relabel legacy flags or infer provider absence from False. Actual provider is absent in these fixtures.
boundary.parser_scope: _SourceTransport validates envelopes; empty/None content can return normally. Its normal return is not a complete-answer or clinical success result. No upper generation function, historical runner or blind export is invoked.
boundary.identity: Within each accepted observed branch assert fake result, helper input and outer return are the same original object; the direct control branch asserts fake result and outer return identity. Direct and observed branches use independent fixture objects with identical fingerprint/payload and compare sanitized legacy fields. Exact canonical JSON before/after proves no mutation. Rejecting wrapper paths have no outer return object; record only fake/observer identity and pinned rejection behavior.
boundary.entry_observability: Count outer_complete_entries, fake_invocations, helper_entries and observer_normal_returns separately. There is no standalone semantic-parser entry hook; do not fabricate parser-entered counts from wrapper entry.
boundary.coverage_limit: Transport.request rejects oversized, invalid JSON, non-dict and truthy error envelopes before returning. This harness observes only synthetic inner-client objects and establishes no broader actual HTTP coverage.

order: Verify permanent synthetic owner and source/request/fixture pins
Exclusively create durable reservation; it consumes this synthetic branch even when later fake count is zero
Persist dispatch-possible marker; this is not a dispatch/response proof
Enter frozen outer wrapper, dispatch registered fake at most once
Observer records in-memory object seen and uses pinned helper; save structural-only receipt exclusively with the previously specified barriers
Only after structural persistence return identical object to frozen wrapper; collect its fixed sanitized outcome and legacy fields
Check source pins and save linked operational result; any saved result cannot certify its own durability, so follow the existing post-barrier commit pattern

storage_contract.reuse: Reuse only pinned exclusive-write primitives (for example _Directory), flush/file-fsync/dir-fsync/snapshot semantics and post-terminal commit ordering. Do not reuse or modify offline _read_chain, fixture classifier or synthetic_eligibility; no full 42-fault rerun or new clinical gate.
storage_contract.failure: Structural write failure prevents observer normal return and post-client semantic validation. A readable partial/full structure file alone never proves its durability. Save fixed stage/code and parsed observation in a separately committed failure receipt when possible. If that save also fails, recover parsed observation as unknown from prior committed disk evidence; later operational results must not reintroduce that in-memory observation as durable truth. In-memory counter/observation evidence remains separately labelled test-only.
storage_contract.interrupt: Interrupt after durable structure but before observer return keeps structure readable; frozen wrapper maps KeyboardInterrupt to interrupted with its flag False. No fabricated normal return.
storage_contract.resumption: Repeated same owner/case and alternate out_name produce zero extra fake calls. No removal of owner/reservation/marker/partial files or stale lock. Direct-control and observed branches are distinct preregistered synthetic branches, never retries.
storage_contract.receipt_fields: Fixed labels/booleans/validated counts, source links and exact helper allowlist only. Never persist str/repr/traceback, arbitrary paths/class names, answer text or reasoning body/hash. Content hash is not anonymization.
storage_contract.completion: No new clinical gate, synthetic four-reply gate or adoption decision is implemented. Existing four-complete prerequisite remains unchanged.
